comment: Plex Lite plugin catalogue (docs/PLUGINS.md). Plex Lite fetches this file from the repo (Settings → Plugins → Browse plugins) and falls back to the copy bundled in the app. Every entry pins the SHA-256 of its code; a download that doesn't match is refused. Web entries are built with tools/build-plugin.mjs. Example and test plugins (examples/plugins) are never published here.
